notes.title: DLCs “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin” and “Jukebox” are now available! 🕹️
notes.content:
PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC Paid DLC “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin” and “Jukebox” are now available! Free updates to improve background music quality and stability are also available!

Now for PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC, the highly rated action-adventure game from Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc., two new paid DLC as well as a free update of the game are both now available for download.

[previewyoutube=N13TPCH2y6E;full][/previewyoutube]
Paid DLC “Chrome Noir Chogokin skin”
PAC-MAN with a black Chogokin robot design! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/20870b5c3ee7ce7edd00d00cc90a45782284bdaa.png

The appearance of Metal PAC-MAN in "Quest Mode" can be changed to “Chogokin PAC-MAN” in the game Options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/c85589b574a6f04e03e0d5adab1e612202be1008.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/e16f17039c511fbfef2db832f947da098d951a9f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/eba85bbc3752ceea9ffd1292fc5fa84219b32271.png

Paid DLC "Jukebox"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/6fc56af67ef4cc785044c68815cfa4a8ddcc5276.png

A jukebox will appear on the beach at Ghost Island. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/4add4fbf03e2182882aa6fda9a149662ac2ba03e.png
At the jukebox, you can change the background music played on Ghost Island by selecting from more than 50 songs in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861159/b5ce0e9c60df5da2fed0ecff033fec5d40b0bce9.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859470/PACMAN_WORLD_RePAC

notes.title: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-Pac is now available! 🕹️
notes.content:
PAC-MAN is back!
PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC, the remake of PAC-MAN’s first foray into 3D platforming is available today!

[previewyoutube=JLhu5ggOKWI;full][/previewyoutube] 

PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC brings back a wonderfully original world of adventure for PAC-MAN, where our hero is now chasing the Ghosts to rescue PAC-MOM, PAC-BOY, PAC-SIS, Professor PAC, PAC-BUDDY, and Pooka from their clutches only to discover a new nemesis in the dreaded TOC-MAN.

Rescue the PAC-FAM from Ghost Island in this remastered classic 3D platformer and guide PAC-MAN through a world full of adventures!

Now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859470/PACMAN_WORLD_RePAC/
